# S3 — MatterThread

> Fixture data. Not market evidence.

## Synthetic control text

One clause changed. Four people left the review with four different next steps.

MatterThread prepares a decision memo from a completed legal-review transcript. It places the changed clause, assigned reviewer, and requested return date into one draft before the project manager circulates it.

A fictional held-out test of 160 synthetic matters labeled owner-and-date extraction at 89%. The label does not represent a law firm, customer, or live deployment.

The tool cannot judge legal meaning, approve language, or replace counsel. Its job is smaller: preserve what the group already assigned so the project manager has a draft to verify.

Review one synthetic matter with MatterThread.

## Synthetic label

- Control outcome label: `78/100`
- Audience match to RelayNote: distant
- Problem match: strong
- Mechanism match: strong
- Transfer permission: structure only; brand, metric, legal context, and claims are vetoed
